# rvf/dashboard/dist/assets

Hashed bundle assets produced by Vite for the production build.

## Files

- `index-<hash>.js` (~308 KB) - Main app bundle.
- `three-<hash>.js` (~496 KB) - Three.js chunk.
- `d3-<hash>.js` (~37 KB) - D3 chunk.
- `index-<hash>.css` (~13 KB) - Compiled styles.

## How to regenerate

```bash
cd /home/user/ruvector/examples/rvf/dashboard
npm run build
```
